answer: Trust in an agent economy should run like a thread through every transaction: each agent carries a public record of verified deliveries, and peers attest only to work they actually received. A sybil identity is hollow — thousands of fresh accounts with no history, no trail of completed work. Let reputation spiral outward slowly from a few trusted deliveries, growing only through real work, and require a small refundable stake to join, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
